name: igris-gatekeeper-mcp
description: Sub-Second Git Bisection and AST Quarantine Engine for GitLab Duo

tools.name: igris_triage_report
tools.description: Evaluates untrusted vulnerability reports through a 4-gate deterministic cascade (G0 Schema, G1 AST Reachability, G2 Isolated Sandbox, G3 Git Bisect) and produces a SHA-256 sealed receipt.

tools.name: igris_bisect_history
tools.description: Performs sub-second automated git bisection (resolving GitLab Issue #989) across commit history to isolate the exact commit hash and author that introduced a regression.

tools.name: igris_audit_diff
tools.description: Pre-merge zero-trust diff auditor that checks merge request diffs for negative-space deleted test assertions, hardcoded secrets, and dangerous execution sinks.

tools.name: igris_probation_status
tools.description: Queries the earned autonomy level (Level 1 Suggest, Level 2 Propose, Level 3 Act) and trust streak under The GitLab Security Standard v1.0.

tools.name: igris_evaluate_action
tools.description: Evaluates agent actions (SUGGEST_FIX, OPEN_MERGE_REQUEST, AUTO_MERGE, DEPLOY) against earned autonomy levels; instantly demotes rogue agents if tests are deleted or secrets are leaked.
